The AgentTeams Manager agent image — the openclaw gateway runtime the
controller spawns for every Manager CR. Composes the shared
agentteams-openclaw candy (openclaw built from the pinned upstream
source commit — the matrix channel extension is not in the npm
openclaw package) and the shared agentteams-cli candy (agt REST
client + mc), then installs the manager agent trees + configs from
the pinned AgentTeams source. The charly-owned start-manager.sh waits
for the controller's in-container services (reachable at the rewritten
URLs through the controller container on the charly network), syncs
the manager workspace from MinIO, renders openclaw.json from the
template, and execs the openclaw gateway. The controller passes
HOME=/root/manager-workspace (hardcoded upstream) and the upstream
agent trees hardcode /root/agentteams-fs + /root/manager-workspace
paths, so the image chmods /root to 755 (traversable by uid 1000)
and pre-creates /root/manager-workspace, /root/agentteams-fs and
/root/.openclaw uid-1000-writable at build time. Rootless: the service
runs as the image user (uid 1000).
